workflow_rationale: This is a diagnostic task requiring root cause analysis of the failed staging sync workflow (run #20772339098) before implementing a fix. The investigation phase must complete successfully to identify the exact failure point, then the fix can be applied and verified.

phases.name: Reproduce & Document Failure
phases.description: Access the failed GitHub Actions run logs and document the exact failure point, error messages, and affected components

subtasks.description: Fetch and analyze failed workflow run logs

verification.instructions: Verify INVESTIGATION.md contains: (1) Exact error message from run #20772339098, (2) Failing step name, (3) Timestamp of failure, (4) Environment context (staging)

subtasks.expected_output: INVESTIGATION.md document with: (1) Complete error log excerpt, (2) Failing workflow step identified, (3) Environment and timing context
subtasks.notes: Created INVESTIGATION.md documenting: (1) Exact error annotation "Process completed with exit code 1" from run #20772339098, (2) Failing step name "Sync data" (step 8), (3) Timestamp of failure 2026-01-07T06:07:13Z-06:07:19Z, (4) Environment context staging. Critical finding: Both staging AND production runs failed with identical pattern, suggesting external API issue rather than environment-specific configuration problem. Full logs require gh CLI authentication.

subtasks.description: Compare staging vs production workflow configurations

verification.instructions: Verify INVESTIGATION.md section documents differences between staging and production configurations (secrets, schedules, checkout refs)

subtasks.expected_output: Documentation of configuration differences that might cause staging-specific failures
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive staging vs production workflow comparison to INVESTIGATION.md documenting: (1) Schedule differences - staging 6 AM UTC, production 7 AM UTC; (2) Checkout ref strategy - staging uses branch HEAD, production uses latest release tag; (3) Environment secrets - same names, different values per environment; (4) Production-only steps - release tag fetch, smoke tests with SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; (5) Cache isolation via environment-specific keys; (6) Analysis conclusion - identical failure pattern in both environments rules out configuration as root cause, points to shared external dependency (Parliament API) or common code bug.

phases.name: Root Cause Analysis
phases.description: Identify the root cause of the sync failure through log analysis, recent code changes review, and environment validation

subtasks.description: Analyze recent commits for workflow/watcher changes

verification.command: git log --since='7 days ago' --oneline --name-only -- .github/workflows apps/watcher | head -30
verification.expected: List of recent commits affecting workflows or watcher service

subtasks.expected_output: List of commits that may have introduced the staging sync failure

subtasks.description: Validate staging environment secrets and configuration

verification.instructions: Verify staging environment has all required secrets: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, B2_KEY_ID, B2_APP_KEY, B2_BUCKET, SENTRY_DSN

subtasks.expected_output: Confirmation that all required secrets exist and are accessible to staging environment

subtasks.description: Formulate root cause hypothesis and document findings

verification.instructions: Verify INVESTIGATION.md contains 'Root Cause' section with: (1) Specific failure reason, (2) Evidence supporting diagnosis, (3) Proposed fix approach

subtasks.expected_output: Root cause identified with clear evidence and proposed solution strategy

phases.name: Implement Fix
phases.description: Apply the identified fix to the affected workflow file(s) or sync script code

subtasks.description: Apply fix to affected workflow or code file

verification.instructions: File modified based on root cause - specific file determined in Phase 2

subtasks.notes: Specific files_to_modify will be determined after Phase 2 completes. Likely candidates: .github/workflows/sync-data.yml or .github/workflows/sync-photos.yml or apps/watcher/index.ts

subtasks.description: Test fix via manual workflow_dispatch trigger

verification.instructions: Navigate to GitHub Actions, trigger affected workflow manually with environment=staging, verify it completes successfully with green checkmark

subtasks.expected_output: Manual workflow run completes successfully without errors

phases.name: Verification & Prevention
phases.description: Verify the fix works reliably, ensure production is unaffected, and document prevention measures

subtasks.description: Verify production sync workflows still function correctly

verification.instructions: Check recent production sync workflow runs (last 3) to ensure no regressions introduced by the fix

subtasks.expected_output: Confirmation that production workflows continue to operate normally

subtasks.description: Update Issue #128 with root cause and solution

verification.instructions: Verify Issue #128 has a comment documenting: (1) Root cause, (2) Fix applied, (3) Verification steps taken, (4) Prevention measures

subtasks.expected_output: GitHub Issue #128 updated with comprehensive solution documentation

subtasks.description: Add monitoring/logging if insufficient for debugging

verification.instructions: If root cause analysis revealed insufficient logging, verify enhanced error handling or logging has been added to prevent future silent failures

subtasks.notes: Only required if Phase 2 identified logging gaps that contributed to difficulty diagnosing the issue

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Not applicable - investigation workflows must be sequential
parallelism.rationale: Investigation workflow requires completing Reproduce → Investigate → Fix → Harden in strict order. Each phase depends on outputs from the previous phase.

acceptance_criteria: Staging sync workflow runs successfully via manual trigger
Production sync workflows continue to function normally
Issue #128 updated with solution and closed
No workflow syntax errors or secret access issues

verification_steps.name: Manual Staging Sync Trigger
verification_steps.command: gh workflow run sync-data.yml --ref staging -f environment=staging
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Workflow completes successfully with all steps green

verification_steps.name: Verify Production Sync Unaffected
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Recent production runs show 'completed' status with 'success' conclusion

verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk investigation task requires manual verification of staging sync fix and confirmation that production workflows remain unaffected. Integration testing via actual workflow runs is critical to validate the fix.

unit_tests.notes: Workflow configuration fixes do not require unit tests. Verification is done via actual workflow execution.

commands: gh workflow run sync-data.yml --ref staging -f environment=staging
integration_tests.notes: Integration test is the manual workflow trigger with staging environment. Must verify successful completion.

e2e_tests.notes: E2E testing not applicable for workflow configuration fixes.
